absolute_maximum.document: MCP4728 Quad DAC with Non-Volatile Memory, DS22187E (2010), Microchip
absolute_maximum.shows: The absolute maximum that made the I2C pull-ups move when the DAC's supply moved: 'All inputs and outputs w.r.t VSS ... -0.3V to VDD+0.3V'. With VDD now the reference's 2.994 V floor, a bus idling at the logic rail's 3.465 V ceiling is 171 mV outside it, so SDA and SCL pull to VREF+ as well. Also the supply figure the reference's load budget counts: I_DD 800 uA typical, 1400 uA maximum with all four channels in normal mode.

factory_default.shows: Table 4-2, EEPROM memory map and factory default settings: every channel ships with D11..D0 = 0, VREF = 1 (internal 2.048 V), PD = 00, gain = 1, and I2C address bits 000

settling_and_its_load.assumes: The settling figure is a typical with no guaranteed bound, so it carries loads.unguaranteed_margin like every other figure of that species on this board.
settling_and_its_load.shows: Analog Output section. TSETTLING is 6 us TYPICAL with no MIN and no MAX column, under Note 8: within 1/2 LSB of the final value when the code changes from 1/4 to 3/4 of full scale. The table header states the conditions every row is quoted into - RL = 5 kohm, CL = 100 pF - which is what the board's threshold nets have to be inside for the 6 us to apply at all.
